$comment: Cover-sheet spec only. The component inventory — ids, groups, captions, parallels and kit handles — lives next to the @Previews as @CatalogComponent annotations under remote-catalog/src/main/kotlin/ee/schimke/wearm3catalog/remote/, exactly as the sibling :catalog does, and the design-artifacts export builds the catalog from those. This file carries only the fields that are not per-component code metadata: the system slug, title, libraries, primary mode, module, hero and the sibling this sheet is compared against. Every sticker is a real RemoteDocument rasterised by the Remote Compose player; the document carries explicit dark-first Material colours, hence the single dark mode and dark display surface, and leaving the surface off would let the preview server's wear/watch heuristic — which `remote-m3` does not match — pick a white stage the white stickers vanish into. `compareWith` names the SIBLING catalog in this repo (:catalog, the kit rendition) by relative spec path, so the compare page pairs the two implementations and carries the kit's own reference artwork, published by that sibling, as a third column. Moved here from :samples:design-catalog-remote-m3 in yschimke/compose-ai-tools (#4588).
